name: Defog
tagline: Natural-language data analyst that turns questions into SQL.
description: Defog is an AI data analyst that converts natural-language questions into SQL across databases, warehouses, and CSVs, returning answers without writing queries. It is built on SQLCoder, the company's own open-source text-to-SQL model, and emphasizes privacy—your data is never sent to or used to train the model. Defog Agents extend it to multi-step SQL, Python, and R workflows.
insight: Open-sourced SQLCoder in 2023, a specialized text-to-SQL LLM that has surpassed 300,000 downloads.

modelSupport.notes: Built on Defog's fine-tuned SQLCoder text-to-SQL model.

edge: Powered by its own open SQLCoder model rather than a general LLM, with a privacy stance that never sends your data to the model.
pros: Connects to many DBs and warehouses
